title: Mastra agent with Postgres memory
description: A Mastra agent that remembers users in Neon Postgres, streams chat for useChat on AI Gateway, and runs a resumable human-in-the-loop review workflow.

environment.name: MASTRA_FUNCTION_TOKEN
environment.description: A random token of at least 32 characters, for example from openssl rand -hex 32, that callers send as Authorization: Bearer <token>. The function requires it because Neon Function URLs are public.

operations.title: Chat with memory
operations.description: Send a POST request with the useChat body and a resourceId to stream a reply. Mastra Memory keeps the thread and a per-user profile in Postgres.

operations.title: Load a thread
operations.description: Send a POST request with a threadId and a resourceId to get the thread's messages in the UIMessage format that useChat reads.

operations.title: Review a draft
operations.description: Send a POST request with a brief to start a workflow that drafts text and suspends until someone reviews it. To resume the run, send its runId with approved and, if you want a revision, feedback.
